create_batch_subclass: create a subclass of Batch implementing to_pb, from_pb, filter, concatenate, and __len__ methods
create_generated_text: create a GeneratedText dataclass with text, generated_tokens, finish_reason, and seed fields
create_tokens: create a Tokens dataclass with token_ids, logprobs, texts, and is_special lists
concatenate_tokens: concatenate two Tokens objects using the __add__ operator to merge their fields
create_generation: create a Generation dataclass with request_id, tokens, generated_text, and top_tokens fields
